archiveTitle: Daily Brief | God of War Laufey Pre-Orders Open

entries.headline: Gears of War: E-Day Teams Up with Prince St. Pizza
entries.summary: Xbox Wire reports a limited collaboration between Xbox and Prince St. Pizza for Gears of War: E-Day. The Emergence Pie is available at locations in the United States and Toronto through November 1; each pie or slice purchase includes a code for an in-game emblem, and a Prototype Lancer-inspired cutter is also offered.
entries.verification: Opened Xbox Wire evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-29 00:00 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Minecraft Dungeons II Highlights Its Interconnected World
entries.summary: In a hands-on preview, Xbox Wire describes Minecraft Dungeons II's connected regions, side quests, dungeons, and seamless travel between biomes. The article says the game is set for a global launch on September 29 and notes its Unreal Engine 5 upgrade.
entries.verification: Opened Xbox Wire evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 21:00 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet Is Set for a Full Reveal in 2027
entries.summary: IGN and VGC independently report that Naughty Dog studio head Neil Druckmann plans a full reveal in 2027, including a closer look at Jordan’s science-fiction adventure. The packet sources add no release-window information.
entries.verification: Opened IGN Games and VGC News evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The editorial timestamp uses the opened IGN report at 08:37 Beijing; both selected reports fall inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Forest of Deceit Adds Six Language Options
entries.summary: Xbox Wire says Forest of Deceit is now localized in six additional languages. The developers describe language support as a way to make the conversation-focused social deduction game easier for friends who speak different languages to play together.
entries.verification: Opened Xbox Wire evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-29 01:00 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: God of War Laufey Pre-Orders Open September 29
entries.summary: PlayStation Blog says God of War Laufey launches on PS5 on February 16, 2027, with pre-orders opening at 10 a.m. local time on September 29. The post details the pre-order bonus and Digital Deluxe Edition and includes new footage of Faye in combat.
entries.verification: Opened PlayStation Blog evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 20:00 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Suri: The Seventh Note Launches on PS5 on October 30
entries.summary: PlayStation Blog announces that Suri: The Seventh Note, the studio's debut game after four years of development, will launch on PS5 on October 30, 2026. The post also describes its Indian cultural influences and says 80 percent of its music was recorded with original analogue instruments.
entries.verification: Opened PlayStation Blog evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 21:06 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE: ACE COMBAT 8 PS5 Edition Holds an 87 Metascore
entries.summary: Denfaminicogamer’s September 28, 18:00 JST snapshot reported an 87/100 Metascore from 53 PS5 reviews on Metacritic. This item records that platform and time-specific review snapshot only.
entries.verification: Opened 電ファミニコゲーマー News evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 17:23 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Kingdom Rush Sets a New Steam Peak for the Original Game
entries.summary: Automaton reports that the original Kingdom Rush reached a new Steam concurrent-player peak of 17,566 in the 24 hours before publication, nearly ten times its previous record. The article says the new installment may have helped draw attention to the series.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 17:19 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered Patch Notes Detail PC and Console Changes
entries.summary: IGN reports that CD Projekt published patch notes detailing changes for PC and console versions. The article says the remaster launches September 29 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2, with free upgrades for owners within the same platform ecosystem.
entries.verification: Opened IGN Games evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 23:14 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Witch the Showdown Developers Explain Its November Early Access Date
entries.summary: After interviewing the developers at Tokyo Game Show, Automaton reports that Witch the Showdown will enter early access on Steam for PC on November 19, with PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions planned for 2027. The developers also discuss the date choice.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 11:10 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Total War: WARHAMMER III Tops 100,000 Steam Players for the First Time in Four Years
entries.summary: Automaton reports that Total War: WARHAMMER III surpassed 100,000 concurrent Steam players, its first time at that level since August 2022. The article connects the renewed activity with a large DLC update adding a new leader and four characters.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 14:05 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Famitsu Sales: September 14–20, 2026: Famitsu Publishes Japan's Physical Game Sales for September 14–20
entries.summary: Gematsu relays Famitsu's Japanese retail chart for September 14–20, 2026. Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave for Nintendo Switch 2 led new releases with 127,131 physical copies sold in its opening week.
entries.verification: Opened Gematsu evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 21:07 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Something is Wrong with the Library Announced for PC
entries.summary: Gematsu relays a publisher press release announcing Something is Wrong with the Library, a haunted book-sorting simulator from Frosty Pop and Strange Scaffold. The game is planned for PC via Steam in fall 2026.
entries.verification: Opened Gematsu evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 21:28 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: つみみじかん 狂オシイホド愛シテル Is Now on Steam
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that Tohakusha released an expanded Final Demo for the PC psychological horror adventure つみみじかん 狂オシイホド愛シテル. It adds character voices, extends play to the middle of DAY 7, and includes UI and presentation improvements.
entries.verification: Opened 4Gamer News Topics evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 19:10 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: みんなでティア表！ Releases a Demo for Up to Six Players
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that BookBook released a demo for みんなでティア表！ on September 28. The party game supports up to six players, who try to guess the rankings in tier lists made by other participants.
entries.verification: Opened 4Gamer News Topics evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 15:36 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: アケノヨスガ - Twilight Loop - Demo Arrives on Steam
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that STUDIO CHARON released a Steam demo for the PC psychological horror adventure アケノヨスガ - Twilight Loop -. Its premise follows a man repeating the same day as he tries to save a girl fated to die.
entries.verification: Opened 4Gamer News Topics evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 15:58 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Former Path of Exile Co-Founder Expects Diablo 5 Could Slip
entries.summary: IGN reports that former Grinding Gear Games co-founder Chris Wilson welcomes Diablo 5's direction but guesses the game may miss Blizzard's stated spring 2029 target. This is Wilson's view, not an announced delay.
entries.verification: Opened IGN Games evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-29 04:17 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: 【悲報】転校生、アイヌ語しか使えない模様: aiGame's Ainu-Language Adventure Launches Free on PLiCy September 30
entries.summary: Automaton reports that aiGame's Ainu-language learning adventure is scheduled to launch for free on PLiCy on September 30. Players learn through dialogue choices, and the article says a preview version was already playable.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-29 09:40 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Normal Golf Game Reaches 98 Percent Positive Steam Reviews
entries.summary: At the time Automaton published its report, Normal Golf Game had 856 Steam user reviews, 98 percent positive, and an Overwhelmingly Positive label. The article also describes its physics-based swing controls.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 10:30 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Link！Like！ラブライブ！ Offline App Will Be Delisted on October 30
entries.summary: Automaton reports that Odd Number will stop offering the offline version on the App Store and Google Play at noon on October 30, ending new installs and redownloads. Paid SIsCa refund requests close at noon on September 30.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 18:34 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Two New The Last of Us Projects Are in Very Early Stages
entries.summary: Automaton reports that Neil Druckmann announced two new The Last of Us projects in very early stages, both intended to expand the canon beyond Part I and Part II. Their format is unknown, so the packet does not establish a Part III game.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-29 08:58 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: WARLOCK: Dungeons & Dragons Developers Discuss Its Magic System
entries.summary: At Tokyo Game Show, Automaton interviewed Invoke Studios developers about WARLOCK: Dungeons & Dragons and its attempt to bring tabletop-style freedom to magic. The report says the single-player third-person action RPG is planned for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC in 2027.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-28 18:37 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4: Modern Warfare 4 XP Tokens Will Count Down Only During Matches
entries.summary: IGN reports that Infinity Ward confirmed double XP tokens in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 will count down only during active matches, starting with the game's launch. Previously, the timer also ran in pre-game lobbies.
entries.verification: Opened IGN Games evidence; it supports the selected facts and copy.
entries.timeNote: The packet source was published at 2026-09-29 05:03 Beijing time, inside the fixed window.
